description: The plot illustrates how loss changes over training time for two methods, with a legend showing “Vanilla” and “SepLLM.” The x-axis is labeled “Training Time (s)” on a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 250,000 seconds with regularly spaced tick labels at 50,000-second intervals (0, 50,000, 100,000, 150,000, 200,000, 250,000). The y-axis is labeled “Loss” on a linear scale, ranging approximately from 2.40 up to about 2.75 with tick labels at 0.05 intervals (e.g., 2.40, 2.45, 2.50, …, 2.75). The “Vanilla” series is drawn as a purple solid line with right-pointing triangle markers; it starts near the top of the axis around 2.75 at the left edge, drops steeply early on, then gradually decreases and flattens around roughly 2.62–2.63 through the mid-to-late training times, ending near about 2.62–2.63 at 250,000 s. The “SepLLM” series is drawn as a red solid line with circular markers; it also begins near about 2.75 at the left edge, declines quickly at first, then continues a slower downward trend to around ~2.60 by roughly the 200,000 s region, and finishes near about 2.60–2.61 at 250,000 s. A green dashed annotation includes a dashed rectangular bracket near the right side and a dashed diagonal guide line, with the text “1.26×” placed above the bracketed region.
